title.narrative: Technology Centre of Expertise to make it easier for FCDO staff to enhance their technology for development offer.

description.narrative: The Tech CoE will make it easier for FCDO staff at post and in policy teams to mobilise the right mix of UK and world-class expertise to enhance their technology for development offer to partner countries. The Tech CoE will: • Deliver a technical assistance facility that provides LMICs with the tools and support to develop their domestic technology ecosystems and to shape the international system to the benefit of all. • Invest in new research to build the global evidence base, consolidate existing evidence and lessons learned and improve knowledge management and signposting to existing evidence and learning resources. • Leverage/deploy British expertise. Enhance the UK brand by promoting experts and institutions and/or showcase our ability to convene experts in a community of practice
